package problemstatment1capmodule1.basic;                                                           
                                                                                                    
public class Main {                                                                                 
                                                                                                    
	public static void main(String[] args) {                                                        
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub                                                          
		        BankingSystem bankingSystem = new BankingSystem();                                  
                                                                                                    
		        // Add new accounts                                                                 
		        Account account1 = new Account("A001", 1000);                                       
		        Account account2 = new Account("A002", 500);                                        
		        Account account3 = new Account("A003", 1500);                                       
                                                                                                    
		        bankingSystem.addAccount(account1);                                                 
		        bankingSystem.addAccount(account2);                                                 
		        bankingSystem.addAccount(account3);                                                 
                                                                                                    
		        // Perform operations                                                               
		        bankingSystem.deposit("A001", 500);                                                 
		        bankingSystem.withdraw("A002", 100);                                                
		        bankingSystem.checkBalance("A001");                                                 
                                                                                                    
		        // Mark account2 as inactive and remove it                                          
		        account2.setActive(false);                                                          
		        bankingSystem.removeInactiveAccounts();                                             
                                                                                                    
		        // Display all active accounts                                                      
		        System.out.println("Active accounts:");                                             
		        bankingSystem.displayAllAccounts();                                                 
                                                                                                    
		        // Display accounts with the highest and lowest balance                             
		        bankingSystem.displayHighestAndLowestBalance();                                     
                                                                                                    
	}                                                                                               
}
